pairs.ref_text: a driver MUST keep to the right-hand lane WHEN a "keep right except to pass" sign is posted UNLESS the driver is passing on a two-lane section where a climbing or passing lane is provided
pairs.model_text: a driver MUST keep to the right-hand lane WHEN the driver is on a [?two-lane section] where a passing lane or climbing lane is provided UNLESS the driver is passing

pairs.ref_text: a driver SHOULD anticipate the extended length AND limited speed of an LCV WHEN preparing to pass it
pairs.model_text: a driver SHOULD anticipate the extended length and limited speed of a long commercial vehicle WHEN preparing to pass the long commercial vehicle on the highway

pairs.ref_text: a driver in [?slow traffic] MUST keep right WHEN on a multi-lane road where a "slower traffic keep right" sign is posted
pairs.model_text: a driver on a multi-lane road MUST keep to the right WHEN the driver's vehicle is [?slow traffic]

pairs.ref_text: a driver MUST NOT pass WHEN a "do not pass" sign applies to the road
pairs.model_text: a driver MUST NOT pass another vehicle WHEN the driver is on a road where a "do not pass" sign is posted

pairs.ref_text: a driver SHOULD NOT pass a pilot vehicle or pace vehicle WHEN it carries the "do not pass" temporary condition sign
pairs.model_text: a driver SHOULD NOT pass a pilot vehicle or pace vehicle WHEN the pilot vehicle or pace vehicle bears a "when flashing" sign with the no-passing symbol AND [?the sign is flashing]

pairs.ref_text: DEFINE a long commercial vehicle IS a double-trailer vehicle THAT can be up to 40 m long AND carries an LCV placard on its rear ALSO CALLED LCV
pairs.model_text: DEFINE a long commercial vehicle IS a double trailer THAT can be up to 40 m in length ALSO CALLED LCV
